name: Website technology batch audit with safe recovery — Data Lantern

parameters.content:
## Safe first use
Execute the default fictional demo first: no HTTP calls and no credential needed.

For live mode, choose your own Header Auth credential (Authorization: Bearer <your Apify token>) on all 3 HTTP nodes. Replace the URLs; set mode to live and allowPaidRun to true only if you approve the configured run budget. Current Actor prices remain unchanged.

To retrieve a previous run, set existingRunId and retain its original URLs; this takes the GET path, not a new paid start. If a start response is lost, inspect Apify Runs before retrying. There is no automatic restart, polling, resubmission or cross-run charge deduplication.

Output: successes, temporary failures, manual-review failures, unobserved URLs and a formula-safe CSV. Retry candidates are suggestions only; never bypass source restrictions.

Actor: https://apify.com/datalantern/tech-stack-detector
